fal_museum_curator.text: The Museum tells the whole story of the islands: the early sealers and whalers, the gauchos from the Pampas, the sheep farms, the wrecks and the war. There's even a section on peat, and a little dress made from Falkland wool.
My favourite things are the old ships' bells, and the photographs of the harbour when it was full of masts.

fal_museum_guide.text: In 1982 the whole of Stanley was under occupation for ten weeks. The museum has stories from islanders: the curfew, the blackouts, the friendly soldiers and the not-so-friendly ones. Most of what we know is from people who were children.
Most of what we know comes from people who were children then, and who tell it better than any book.
